title: Micro-vignette fix ledger and ask synthesis (April 2026)
summary: Compact ledger of small customer vignettes collected between Mar 20–Apr 10 2026, distilled into prioritized micro-asks and near-term quick patches. Focus: low-effort, high-impact fixes that unblock production interference (billing attribution, warm cache behavior, fallback reliability) and hypotheses for small product experiments.
notes: Context: this doc is a synthesis from 18 short field notes (support + AMs) and five product triage calls. Each vignette below is intentionally short — 1–3 lines — with the customer quote, impact, and a quick suggested mitigation. We intentionally bias toward fixes that can be shipped as console toggles, routing policy defaults, or docs clarifications. Several asks map to infra (KV cache warming, autoscale burst config) and one maps to telemetry (per-route token attribution).
micro_vignettes: Customer A (fintech): 'We saw a huge spike in tokens after a rollout — can't tell which route caused it.' Impact: billing disputes and delayed renewals. Mitigation: per-route token breakdown in Console and CSV export.

Customer B (marketplace): 'Can we pin a smaller quantized variant for AB tests? The variance in outputs is scaring product owners.' Impact: blocks rapid experiments. Mitigation: offer a 'canary-quantize' flag with fidelity checks in rollout UI.

Customer C (healthcare on Private): 'Onboarding the on-prem package took 6 weeks; network setup and KMS steps were unclear.' Impact: delayed pilot. Mitigation: step-by-step Private onboarding checklist + sample terraform module.

Customer D (SaaS): 'Function-calling sometimes drops the last tool result on retries.' Impact: user-visible incorrect responses. Mitigation: add deterministic retry semantics and a retry-trace in logs.

Customer E (adtech): 'Burst autoscale doesn't trigger quickly enough for short spikes; latency spikes.' Impact: search-product SLAs breached. Mitigation: shorter burst window config and a 'fast-burst' policy template.

Customer F (ML infra): 'KV cache cold starts add 40ms on many requests — warming is awkward.' Impact: tail latency. Mitigation: expose cache-warm API and pre-warm recommendations per model/seq-length.

Customer G (legal): 'Audit logs don't show which model variant answered — just 'model: gpt-like'.' Impact: compliance review friction. Mitigation: add model-variant id and rollout tag to audit entries.

Customer H (embed-heavy app): 'Embedding dims differ between our old and new model and break our vector DB pipeline.' Impact: production breakages. Mitigation: console warning on embedding-dim mismatch and migration guide.
Customer I (education): 'We need per-user token caps to stop abuse during open beta.' Impact: cost overruns. Mitigation: per-api-key token quotas and soft-limit alerts.

Customer J (platform team): 'We don't know when requests are falling to fallback models.' Impact: hard to correlate quality dips. Mitigation: add 'fallback_reason' in trace/span metadata and dashboard widget.
Customer K (enterprise): 'Dedicated GPU pools feel opaque — what exactly is my headroom?' Impact: procurement concerns. Mitigation: capacity meters and predicted throughput at current config.

Customer L (start-up): 'The tokenize/price estimator is confusing for batched vs streaming calls.' Impact: billing surprises. Mitigation: make estimator mode explicit and show per-path example calculations.
prioritized_requests: Per-route token & cost CSV export (HIGH) — helps resolve billing disputes quickly; product request from three mid-market accounts.
Console toggle: 'Enable fast-burst autoscale' (MED-HIGH) — template policy and recommended thresholds for p95 workloads.
Audit log enhancement: include model-variant id & rollout tag (HIGH) — required by two regulated customers for compliance reviews.
Per-api-key token quota soft limits + email alerts (MED) — low-effort guardrail for beta customers.
Fallback visibility: add 'fallback_reason' to traces and a per-route fallback-rate metric (MED) — aids root cause for quality regressions.
Embedding-dimension migration guide + warning in Console (LOW-MED) — reduces operator errors during model swaps.
Cache-warm API and sample script for pre-warming KV caches (MED) — decreases tail latency for cold starts.
Quantized-canary rollout flag in Console with fidelity smoke checks (LOW-MED) — supports safe experiments on cheaper variants.
quick_patches: Docs: Add 'how to read billing CSV' mini-guide — owner: Documentation; ETA: 1 week.
Console: show model-variant id on request detail panel — owner: Console; ETA: 2 sprints.
Support playbook: template email for cost-dispute triage including steps to pull per-route logs — owner: CS ops; ETA: 3 days.
Runbook: 'fast-burst' sample policy JSON in repo and Console snippets — owner: SRE/Infra; ETA: 2 weeks.
Telemetry: add fallback reason tag to spans (instrumentation only) — owner: Observability; ETA: 1 sprint.
open_questions: How many customers would use per-route CSV exports vs API-only access? (need analytics query: count of routes with >100k tokens/month).
Which teams can implement 'cache-warm' API fastest? (candidate: serving-runtime + infra).
What compliance fields are required for audit logs beyond variant id (legal to confirm)?
Is there appetite to make 'fast-burst' default for certain tiers (pricing implications)?
suggested_next_steps: 1) Quick wins: Docs playbook + support template (CS ops + Docs) — target: end of next week.
2) Instrumentation sprint: fallback tags + model-variant in logs (Observability + Serving) — scoping meeting this week.
3) Product spike: per-route billing export UX and backend requirements — PM + Billing + Console to prototype; propose spec by May 5.
4) Pilot program: offer 'fast-burst' policy to three customers for 4 weeks and measure p95 tail latency and cost delta — owners: SRE + Solutions Eng.
5) Follow-up: convert this ledger into three JIRA epics (billing, telemetry, cache/autoscale) and attach customer vignettes as examples.
